description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copies of Magic Pot that is a 1/1 Soldiers and a Food token
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot and Food, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot token dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure and a Food token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food or Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
